title: Wada Bhen Te Bhira Da, Wada Bhen Te Bhira Da
body:
Kal Fajr Tou Maasooma Meri Tere Hawaale
Tere Putr Mere Meri Ye Dhee Tere Hawaale
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Koofe Shaheed Hoya Te Ek Watn Reya Ae
Ek Toranga Kal Jeda Ke Sultaan E Wafa Ae
Jeda Bacheya O Beemar Vi Hai Tere Hawaale
<<DIVIDER>>
Karbal Da Ae Maidaan Fatah Karna Ae Kal Main
Ek Sajda Te Phir Tenu Vidaa Karna Ae Kal Main
Bazaar Te Darbaar Shaqi Tere Hawaale
<<DIVIDER>>
Tere Aun O Mohammed Te Main Kal Karlene Qurbaan
Akbar Vi Tere Lai Ae Bas Ek Raat Da Mehmaan
Meri Bhen Main Ae Nasl Kiti Tere Hawaale
<<DIVIDER>>
Main Raet De Tibbiyaan Daan Te Sehra Waan Da Zaamin
Main Shaam Payi Ookhiyaan Sabraan Waala Zaamin
Aur Shaam Di Har Tang Gali Tere Hawaale
